key_insight: SolCloudLLM combines sky images with time-series data in a bidirectional multimodal LLM framework to better forecast PV power and GHI, especially when clouds drive rapid changes.
engineering_relevance: For solar plant operation and grid scheduling, the approach improves short-term forecast reliability at site-specific locations where observational data are limited.
method: Aligns sky-image patches with time-series patches
Fuses both modalities through bidirectional multimodal fusion
Maps the unified representation into an LLM embedding space for forecasting
evidence_signal: Across SIRTA and SKIPP'D, the method outperformed the best baselines on MSE for all horizons, with up to 25.4% relative MSE reduction, and was strongest under cloudy conditions and few-shot settings.
watch_item: The multimodal pipeline depends on synchronized, site-specific image and sensor data, which may limit deployment where camera coverage or labeled data are sparse.
paper_title: Bidirectional Multimodal Fusion of Sky Images and Time-Series for Solar Forecasting with Large Language Models
